CO_F.description: Floor Load Display Color (CO_F). Sets the display colors (wire frame, hidden fill, hidden edge) and blending for a floor load type; NAME identifies which existing floor load type the color is applied to and each key is that floor load type's id.

NAME.description: Floor load type name. Must match an existing floor load type; if no floor load type with this name exists the write is rejected.

WF_R.description: Wire frame color, red channel (0-255). Unspecified channels keep the existing value.

WF_G.description: Wire frame color, green channel (0-255). Unspecified channels keep the existing value.

WF_B.description: Wire frame color, blue channel (0-255). Unspecified channels keep the existing value.

HF_R.description: Hidden fill color, red channel (0-255). Unspecified channels keep the existing value.

HF_G.description: Hidden fill color, green channel (0-255). Unspecified channels keep the existing value.

HF_B.description: Hidden fill color, blue channel (0-255). Unspecified channels keep the existing value.

HE_R.description: Hidden edge color, red channel (0-255). Unspecified channels keep the existing value.

HE_G.description: Hidden edge color, green channel (0-255). Unspecified channels keep the existing value.

HE_B.description: Hidden edge color, blue channel (0-255). Unspecified channels keep the existing value.

OPT_BLEND.description: Blending on/off for the hidden fill display.

BLEND_FACTOR.description: Blending factor used when OPT_BLEND is true (0.0-1.0).
